Irene / Neha — I've reviewed the SCIM and Admin-RBAC tabs and added inline comments. Key notes below (paste these into the final PDF under "Technical clarifications"):

- SCIM provisioning: Redwood implements SCIM 2.0 endpoints for Users and Groups. We support bulk GET and PATCH for groups via the /Groups endpoint. For group membership changes we prefer PATCH with "Operations" (+/-) semantics; our SDKs accept both incremental PATCH and full replace PUT for group membership. In conflict scenarios (concurrent patch from IdP vs. API), the last-write-wins policy is applied with a server timestamp; we record the originating principal in audit logs for traceability.

- Attributes and mapping: we map: userName, id, displayName, mail, givenName, familyName, externalId, member (array of user IDs), and enterpriseUser extension for manager and employeeType. For groups we sync displayName, id, externalId and members. We include a recommended attribute mapping sheet (see attached diagram).

- Admin roles & delegation: Redwood has three built-in admin roles: Org Admin, Admin Operator, and Viewer. Org Admin can manage org-level settings and create delegated admin scopes. Admin Operator can manage deployments and users within a delegated tenant. Viewer is read-only. Delegated admin enforcement is implemented via scoped tokens and an internal ACL that resolves to RBAC rules at request time. All admin actions are logged to our audit cluster with actor, action, resource, and request id.

I've attached the SCIM mapping diagram and a short sample of an audit log row (redacted). I flagged one question in the spreadsheet about whether Silverpine prefers IdP-initiated SAML or SP-initiated flows for their primary user base.

Alex — thanks for the questionnaire and timeline. Attached is a consolidated response packet (PDF) that covers SSO, SCIM, RBAC, and admin controls. Highlights: 

- SSO: Redwood supports both IdP-initiated and SP-initiated SAML SSO. We also support OIDC Authorization Code flow with PKCE for modern integrations. We can optionally expose IdP-initiated SLO; behavior depends on customer IdP session semantics (we document expected flows).
- SCIM: SCIM 2.0 for Users and Groups; we recommend PATCH for incremental group membership updates. We include an attribute mapping sheet and a diagram of our sync flow. Bulk operations are supported for initial provisioning via our import tool.
- RBAC & delegated admin: three core admin roles plus customizable role templates. Delegation is enforced via scoped tokens and an ACL lookup at request time; all admin operations emit audit events with actor, scope, resource, and request_id.

Attached evidence: redwood_silverpine_answers-v1.pdf (consolidated answers + screenshots), scim-mapping-diagram.png, sample-audit-log-row.txt. We've also placed the editable questionnaire and source diagrams in a shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cSilverpineIAM

Per your ask, we set up a test account (test+silverpine@redwood.com) for validation. Please let us know a preferred time for a short connection test; Ben is available Wed/Thu mornings PST.
